title: Trim the Paragraphs
description: Learn how to jump — or delete — by sentence, not just by word.

objective: The first paragraph's bad sentence comes first — delete forward onto it.
The second is the same shape — repeat the change instead of redoing it.
The third's bad sentence is last instead of first.
The fourth is the same shape as the third — repeat that change instead.
The fifth is found by searching for it, not by counting lines.
The sixth — mark where it starts, glance ahead, then come back and remove it.
The seventh has two bad sentences in a row — remove both in one move.
The eighth — select it visually up to the next sentence, then remove it.
